description: This file defines the DynamicType class and related constants, macros, and functions for a lightweight, bit-based type system used in TorchScript, focusing on runtime type representation and subtyping logic.

classes.name: DynamicType
classes.description: Represents a lightweight, bit-based dynamic type used for TorchScript runtime type analysis and subtyping.

classes.name: DynamicType::Arguments
classes.description: Holds a list of labeled dynamic types as arguments for DynamicType instances.

classes.name: DynamicType::LabeledDynamicType
classes.description: Associates an optional label with a DynamicType, supporting named types like NamedTuple.

methods.name: DynamicType::equals
methods.description: Checks if this type is equal to another type.

methods.name: DynamicType::isSubtypeOfExt
methods.description: Determines if this type is a subtype of another, with detailed reason output.

methods.name: DynamicType::str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the type.

methods.name: DynamicType::create
methods.description: Factory method to create a DynamicType instance from a Type.

methods.name: DynamicType::tag
methods.description: Returns the tag enum value representing the specific type.

methods.name: DynamicType::name
methods.description: Returns the optional name of the type.

methods.name: DynamicType::arguments
methods.description: Returns the arguments associated with the type.

methods.name: DynamicType::dynamicKind
methods.description: Returns the kind of dynamic type.

methods.name: DynamicType::fallback
methods.description: Returns fallback static type info, used on server side.
